errors.text_span: including a slight increase at epoch 2
errors.evidence: This phrase is used to describe the 'tiny full' model, but the plot shows that the WER for the 'tiny full' model (gray line) decreases between epoch 1 (approx. 27.2) and epoch 2 (approx. 26.9). It is the 'base full' model that shows a slight increase at epoch 2.
